name: Spring-balanced desk lamp
notes: Size corrected after first gate: 34 cm arms at a working pose reach about 30 cm forward of the base; width includes the cable lying on the desk.
parts: lower twin arms and upper twin arms with knuckle joints
four coil tension springs near the base
domed shade with rolled rim and rear cap
style: 1930s British engineering, satin black enamel with polished chrome springs and knuckles
summary: Spring-balanced desk lamp after the Anglepoise 1227: stepped cast base, twin parallel arms, four tension springs, domed shade.
